raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.11.2"

package:
  name: meson
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/mesonbuild/meson/releases/download/${{ version }}/meson-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 698feae069cef3ecd4d7aaf281d7df359bdfcf555a9a1564383d3b913fa8a736
  patches:
    # See conda-forge/glib-feedstock#40 for documentation regarding the RPATH patch
    - patches/0001-Only-fix-RPATH-if-install_rpath-is-not-empty.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  noarch: python
  python:
    entry_points:
      - meson = mesonbuild.mesonmain:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - ninja >=1.8.2

tests:
  - script:
      - meson -h
      - meson -v
      - meson --internal delsuffix . nomatchqqq  # test reexecution (GitHub issue #11)
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://mesonbuild.com
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: The Meson Build System
  documentation: https://mesonbuild.com
  repository: https://github.com/mesonbuild/meson

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dirmeier
    - pkgw
    - SoapZA
    - wolfv
    - tschoonj
    - rgommers
    - h-vetinari
